item.title: Anger Is An Emotion Too
item.description: Society, for centuries, has punished certain emotions depending on who expresses them. Women’s sadness, anxiety, and frustration are often labeled as irrational or an overreaction. Meanwhile, men’s anger is normalized, and in some settings, even respected or excused as natural behavior. But we make a crucial mistake when we forget that anger, too, is an emotion. <p>The post Anger Is An Emotion Too first appeared on Her Campus.</p>
